title: Advanced Complex Subordination
summary: Complex subordinate clauses in formal and academic Turkish.
explanation: Advanced syntactic structures like '-duğundan dolayı' or '-dığı için' are used in formal, literary, or academic writing for complex causation.

example_translations.ex_trcomp_1: He/She is very successful because he/she reads books.

common_error_explanations.err_trcomp_1: Use advanced subordinating postpositions in formal writing.
